events.text:
T-197 is in review, but I did not publish the mirror or deploy the Worker, so the mirror still lacks the O013 fix.

- **O013:** The old centre's Join button and calendar now read the attendee's own Zoom link at runtime (commit 729da61). I did not re-run the local-centre check this session; I'm relying on the earlier `probe-own-join.mjs` result of 16/16.
- **AUDIT.md:** No P0 row is open without a task.
  - X001 to X003 are fixed in T-260.
  - X051 is tracked in T-260.
  - H056 is fixed in T-122, and O013 and M033 are fixed.
  - AUDIT.md sits outside the repo, in `[redacted]`. The rows already read this way, so I made no edit.
- **`probe-details.mjs`:** It now shows 0 FAIL, with 30 WARN. I ran it in static-check mode only, with no served mirror or admin link. Two FAILs came from verbatim client dates under `workshop-plan/library`, so I made the probe skip that folder (commit 419ef5c).
- **Publish:** I didn't merge or push, because the shared tree has other lanes' uncommitted work, and `main` has diverged from `origin/main` (121 local commits, 26 remote). No Worker code changed, so I skipped the Worker deploy.
